transport: Reliable ordered SCTP data channels in existing peer DTLS connections; direct mesh delivery; no chat payloads sent to signaling or video forwarders
persistence: Live in-memory chat only; cleared on leaving/kick/sign-out; no history replay to late joiners

validation.signedNativeBrowserIntegration: passed: five browser peers plus Mac; bidirectional Unicode text and 70,000-byte binary files with byte comparison; consent before transfer; native image preview widget; native Chat dialog; live encrypted media/opaque forwarding; mute/kick/reuse regressions; chat cleared on leaving
validation.browserImagesAndSecurity: passed: actual image decode, literal HTML text, received binary download byte comparison, malformed metadata, unsolicited data rejection, wrong offsets, corrupt hashes, memory cap, departure and cancellation
validation.delayedChannelTeardown: passed: retired peer channel is closed after leaving; native/browser integration still passes with guards
validation.retiredNativeSendFailure: passed: send failure from replaced channel cannot remove replacement
validation.publicVerification: health 0.3.9; HTML/JS/CSS match source; CSP permits local image Blobs; full HTTPS archive hash matches signed release
validation.installedMac: 1.0.10+11 universal arm64/x86_64; strict code signature verified; executable hash matches release; app reopened
validation.productionDatabase: integrity ok; users, friends, meeting roster, controls, open policies and blocks preserved; no chat database tables
validation.nativeFilePanels: sandboxed NSOpenPanel/NSSavePanel compiled and reviewed; native picker/save dialogs not automated
validation.mediaScope: synthetic local integration; physical capture and WAN performance not exercised
